GUIDE.TITLE: User Guide
GUIDE.INTRO: A short tour of what you can do here and how to get around, including a few tricks built specifically for keyboard and screen reader use.
GUIDE.JUMP_ADVISOR: Jump to the advisor dashboard guide ↓
GUIDE.JUMP_REVIEWER: Jump to the reviewer dashboard guide ↓
GUIDE.OVERVIEW_BODY_1: Home is where you land after signing in. Paste the URL of a job posting there and choose "Use for new company" to pre-fill a new company entry from it, or "Search" to look at it first without saving anything.
GUIDE.OVERVIEW_BODY_2: The account menu in the top-right corner — where you opened this guide — also holds your profile, the language switcher, and Log out. It stays in the same place on every page.
GUIDE.COMPANIES_BODY_1: Companies holds every company you're interested in, each with its own locations and open positions. Add one by hand, or import it from a .json file if you already have the details written down. From any position, choose "Apply" to turn it into an application.
GUIDE.COMPANIES_BODY_2: Applications tracks the status of everything you've applied for, from Draft through Sent, Interview scheduled, Interview done, up to an Offer, Accepted, Rejected or Withdrawn. Use the search box and the year/month filters above the table to find one quickly, and change the status directly from its row.
GUIDE.DOCUMENTS_BODY_1: Documents is where you upload reusable cover letter templates as .docx files, each with a label and a language so you can tell them apart.
GUIDE.DOCUMENTS_BODY_2: On the Applications page, pick one of your templates next to an application and download it as a finished PDF or Word file — the company and position details are filled in for you automatically.
GUIDE.SHORTCUTS_INTRO: From anywhere outside a form field, these keys jump straight to a section of the main navigation:
GUIDE.SHORTCUTS_WINDOWS_NOTE: On Windows, hold Alt+Shift with the key, since screen readers there reserve bare letters for their own browse-mode navigation. On other platforms, press the bare letter.
GUIDE.A11Y_SKIP_LINK: A "Skip to main content" link appears as soon as you press Tab, so you can bypass the navigation on every page.
GUIDE.A11Y_LANDMARKS: Navigation is grouped into labeled regions per role, and the link for the page you're on is always marked as current.
GUIDE.A11Y_SORT: Sortable table columns cycle through ascending, descending and unsorted, announcing the change each time.
GUIDE.A11Y_ALERTS: Errors are marked so they're announced immediately, and empty tables say so explicitly instead of just showing nothing.
GUIDE.A11Y_LANGUAGE: Switching language in the account menu is announced out loud, since the page content changes without a reload.
GUIDE.ADVISOR_BODY_1: My Users lists the people currently assigned to you, with their name and email.
GUIDE.ADVISOR_BODY_2: Use Create Suggestion to point one of your users at an open position, with an optional note explaining why. My Suggestions keeps a record of everything you've sent and whether it was accepted, rejected, or is still pending.
GUIDE.REVIEWER_BODY_1: Users requesting review groups every person who has shared documents with you. Open a person's table to see what they've shared and when access was granted, and download any file directly from its row.
